Recent Norwich Jobs

Thorpe Marriott, Costessey and the City Centre

Run From Norwich

Gary's Base Since 2010

Gary Worman started GMW in 2010 alongside his work as a mechanical engineer, qualifying as a mechanical engineer and as an electrician in the same month, and went full time in 2012. Today it's Gary as the electrician plus a builder, working out of Norwich on homes, building sites and commercial premises.

Close to the city, the villages and towns on Gary's own Norwich list are Aylsham, Holt, Reepham, North Walsham, Wymondham and Cringleford.
